card.name: Inside all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Words inside ALL-CAPS warning or notice sentences, such as EMERGENCY, OBSOLETE, YOU and HALF. It also fires on a few words in title-case headline lists.

modes.label: All-caps warnings
modes.description: A word within a capitalised boxed warning or notice sentence, often partway through a long word.
modes.example: DRUG. SERIOUS ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY REQUIRE TREATMENT WITH EPINEPHRINE AND OTHER EMER<<GENCY>> MEASURES, INCLUDING OXYGEN

modes.label: Article title lists
modes.description: A word or question mark inside a headline in a list of article titles.
